description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'TestConfig' in the package 'com.orangehrm.config'. It provides centralized configuration management for a test suite, allowing retrieval of environment-specific settings such as base URL, username, password, browser type, and headless mode. The class loads properties from a properties file if available, and uses system properties and environment variables to override defaults. It also provides a method for masking sensitive information like passwords in logs.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A utility class for managing test configuration settings with layered overrides (system properties, environment variables, properties file, defaults). Contains methods for retrieving configuration values and masking sensitive data.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the OrangeHRM application under test.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the default username for authentication tests.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the default password for authentication tests, emphasizing that it should be provided via environment variable or system property for security reasons.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the browser type to use for test execution.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Indicates whether tests should run in headless mode.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Masks sensitive string values for secure logging, revealing only a portion of the string.
